cases.assertion: legacy root workspace operations keep their existing omitted-repo behavior
multi layout operations without repo are invalid
an empty root workspace remains supported
a single repository root workspace remains supported
multi layout can attach two repositories in distinct child paths
detaching A does not delete or change B
absolute paths, dot segments, symlink escapes, and reserved names are rejected
nested or case-insensitive overlapping repository paths are rejected
max_repos and max_bytes are enforced before attach
read access rejects commit and push with repo_read_only
each repository push still obeys workspace push branch policy
operation A does not decrypt or depend on repository B credential
clone sync and push authorize only the repository host within tenant policy
archive restore and copy preserve all repository paths and uncommitted changes
workspace operation golden history replays before and after the multi-repo change
another tenant or user cannot list, read, attach, detach, or operate repositories
